items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Most orders arrive within 30 to 45 minutes. At peak times on Friday and Saturday evenings it can take up to an hour.

items.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
items.answer: Yes, within 5 minutes of ordering. After that the kitchen has already started and the order can no longer be changed.

items.question: What happens if I am not home?
items.answer: The rider calls you and waits 5 minutes. If there is no answer the order is left at the door and marked as delivered.
